newsContext.title: Ether ETF flows reverse before today's rally
newsContext.summary: Cointelegraph reports $29.8m left spot Ether ETFs in Thursday's session, after $34.8m entered on Wednesday. This is a report published today about prior-session flows, not today's completed ETF total.
newsContext.originalTitle: Bitcoin ETF outflows accelerate as investors pull $449M in three days
newsContext.whyItMatters: ETF flows and an intraday ETH rally can point in different directions. This report does not support an ETF-inflow explanation for today's move. Today's full ETF session is not complete.

newsContext.title: Today's institutional outlook includes an ETH target
newsContext.summary: A Friday report covered by Cointelegraph cites Standard Chartered's $18,000 Ether forecast for end-2028 while discussing Sky's DeFi outlook. This is the bank's long-term forecast, not our prediction or evidence explaining today's price move.
newsContext.originalTitle: Standard Chartered forecasts SKY rising fivefold to $0.325 by 2028
newsContext.whyItMatters: Separate a long-term institutional thesis from a near-term catalyst. A target is not a guaranteed outcome or a trade signal.
